definitions.explanation: A drinking establishment, typically modeled on a British or Irish pub, that serves beer and bar food. Casual atmosphere with table or counter seating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧{帰|がえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧パブ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped by a pub on the way home from work.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧パブ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生|なま}ビール→生ビール：23496_namabiiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This pub has a wide variety of draft beers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧アイリッシュパブ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: We had a great time with friends watching the match at an Irish pub.

notes:
Loanword from English 'pub' (originally 'public house'). In Japan, often used for Western-style drinking spots that emphasize beer and standing or table service, in contrast to a ⟦スナック→スナック：27527_sunakku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アイリッシュパブ: Irish pub
- ブリティッシュパブ: British pub
- スポーツパブ: sports pub
- パブ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink at a pub

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧: bar — broader; covers cocktail bars, hotel bars, etc.
- ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧: izakaya — Japanese-style pub, food-focused, very different atmosphere
- ⟦スナック→スナック：27527_sunakku⟧: small Japanese-style bar with a hostess; different culture from a パブ
